lineage.strategy: Reuse the packet's defensible primary Q2 source but extract source-addressed numeric operating, segment, cash-flow and balance-sheet facts that prior Scout evidence had not packaged for Alpha; no numeric underwriting judgment is made.

observations.fact: Q2 2026 revenue was $17.162B versus $16.977B in Q2 2025, about 1% reported growth; six-month revenue was $33.079B versus $31.519B.
Q2 Software revenue was $7.761B, up 5.1% year over year; Red Hat grew 11%, Data grew 19%, while Transaction Processing declined 8%.

Q2 Consulting revenue was $5.327B, essentially flat reported and up 1.1% at constant currency; Infrastructure revenue was $3.835B, down 7.4%, with IBM Z down 42% and Distributed Infrastructure up 37%.
Q2 GAAP gross margin was 57.7%, down 1.0 point year over year; GAAP pre-tax income was $2.5B, down 5%, while operating non-GAAP pre-tax income was $3.3B, up 3%.
First-half 2026 operating cash flow was $7.8B and IBM-defined free cash flow was $4.8B, flat year over year. Q2 free cash flow was $2.5B, down $0.3B year over year.

IBM ended Q2 with $8.2B of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities, down $6.3B from year-end 2025 after $10.5B of acquisition investment; total debt was $62.0B, including $13.0B of IBM Financing debt.
Management raised full-year constant-currency revenue-growth expectations to 4%-5% and maintained an expectation for free cash flow to increase by about $1B year over year.

IBM reported nearly $500M of order backlog in Distributed Infrastructure and said Red Hat, watsonx, HashiCorp and Confluent were among high-growth portfolio areas aligned with strongest client demand.

risks.risk: Headline consolidated growth is weak relative to strategic AI/hybrid-cloud positioning, with material internal dispersion across Software, Transaction Processing and Infrastructure.
Acquisition deployment materially reduced cash while debt remained large; Alpha should separate acquisition-driven growth from organic operating progress before assigning numeric score evidence.

contradictions.contradiction: Management raised full-year constant-currency revenue expectations despite only about 1% reported Q2 revenue growth and late-quarter revenue headwinds.
Software and Distributed Infrastructure growth coexist with sharp declines in Transaction Processing and IBM Z, so portfolio-level momentum cannot be inferred from one growth segment.

unknowns.unknown: Current market valuation and valuation opportunity are not established by this source.
The source does not isolate organic growth excluding acquisitions or quantify incremental revenue attributable specifically to current AI offerings.

recommendation: Use these source-addressed numeric facts as underwriting inputs; reconcile organic versus acquisition-driven growth, valuation, factor calibration, risk evidence and data-confidence evidence before any numeric score record.
